batching_limitation.reason: qa_turn_helper.py:243 forces MESSAGE_BATCH_WINDOW_SECONDS=0, bypassing the message batcher entirely. The harness is synchronous (inject → wait for response), making true sub-5-second multi-message batching structurally impossible. Each turn call blocks until the bot responds before the next message can be injected. Batching behavior was NOT tested in this run — the 3 persona messages were sent as sequential synchronous turns instead.
batching_limitation.workaround: Messages were sent as 3 separate turns (T1=Hola, T2=Quiero un corte, T3=Para mañana por la tarde si puede ser) to observe the bot's behavior when each arrives independently.
batching_limitation.recommendation: To properly test the batcher, inject 3 XADD calls to INCOMING_STREAM within a 3s window using a raw Redis client script, then wait for a single response. This requires a new harness mode that does not call capture_response between injections.
